profile.headline: Software Developer at MedBill
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer fueled by a passion for innovation. Graduated in 2018 with an Associate's degree in Computer Science. Proficient in full-stack development with expertise in React, Redux, MobX, C#, Entity Framework, ASP.NET Core, TSQL, and PSQL. Committed to delivering high-quality code and continuously staying updated with emerging technologies. Thrives in collaborative environments and embraces challenges with a creative problem-solving approach. Let's connect and explore new opportunities to drive innovation together.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leveraged TSQL scripting to streamline internal reporting processes, enabling efficient analysis and monitoring of internal software systems.
- Employed C# and React to revamp an internal website dedicated to tracking financial transactions and payments, resulting in enhanced accuracy and transparency.
- Collaborated on the development of the main website, utilizing C# and React to optimize invoice generation and facilitate seamless money transactions.
- Implemented Azure Hosting for the Company's flagship website, ensuring reliable performance and data management, including secure deletion protocols.
- Utilized PostgresSQL for crafting comprehensive scripts that empowered reporting capabilities on Azure-hosted websites, while providing data update functionalities required.
- Utilized Azure DevOps (ADO) as a project management tool to prioritize and address client-driven tasks.
- Leveraged Selenium to access and navigate external websites, enabling the secure and efficient retrieval of vital third-party reports. This approach facilitated the streamlined processing of valuable data within internal systems, enhancing the overall efficiency of the operations.
- Used Selenium to access a third-party website to download reports to allow for report data migration, saving the company thousands

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Employed Agile methodologies using Jira and Azure DevOps (ADO) to manage and fulfill client requirements, improving the website's functionality.
- Utilized React.js with Redux and MobX to create an intuitive user interface (UI), empowering clients to customize forms, upload documents and schedule CSV reports.
- Leveraged C# and Entity Framework to save and retrieve UI data, supporting real-time updates and efficient database integration. Implemented robust backend processes in C#, automating claim submissions, generating PDFs, and producing comprehensive XLSX and CSV reports. Conducted thorough unit tests to ensure code stability and compliance with evolving requirements.
- Migrated from MSSQL to PostgresSQL, utilizing its capabilities to store and manage client data. Crafted scripts for data access, monitoring, editing, and quick bug fixes, ensuring uninterrupted functionality and an exceptional user experience.
- Applied MVC with ASP.NET to maintain and enhance internal websites, enabling efficient time tracking for employees and generating insightful reports for supervisors. These reports facilitated process improvement, optimizing internal operations.

positions.title: Programmer Internship
positions.description:
- Utilized MSSQL to create and modify stored procedures for overnight data processing. This involved editing and updating data received from a third-party website, enabling seamless internal submission of claims to insurance companies by employees.
- Collaborated with the development team, utilizing skills in C# and React, to identify and resolve code issues. Helped implement new forms as requested by clients, ensuring their requirements were met.
positions.insights: SQL, Microsoft SQL Server and +3 skills

positions.locationName: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Provided exemplary customer service by promptly addressing inquiries, resolving concerns, and offering guidance on product selection.

- Managed and supervised a team of cashiers, ensuring smooth workflow and adherence to company policies and procedures.

- Trained and mentored new cashiers, fostering a positive and supportive work environment while promoting operational excellence.

- Operated cash registers with precision, accurately processing transactions and handling cash with integrity.

- Collaborated with management to address escalated customer issues, seeking effective resolutions and maintaining customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
- Operated the cash register with accuracy and speed, ensuring smooth and efficient checkout experiences for customers.

- Responded to customer inquiries promptly and courteously, providing helpful information and addressing concerns to the best of my ability.
